title: Open Bucket, Closed Door
subtitle: Find Vela Retail's anonymous backup bucket and lock it down
summary: Vela Retail's backup bucket inherited a public ACL. Browse it anonymously, capture the internal marker from a database snapshot, then require an access key for backups without breaking the public CDN.
scenario: A routine cloud review at Vela Retail checks whether storage buckets match their intended exposure. The CDN bucket is meant to be public; the nightly database exports are not. Find what is world-readable, prove the exposure, and apply the correct ACL policy.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with object storage concepts
learningObjectives: Assess the impact of exposed backups
Apply bucket-level access control and verify both denial and allowed access
authorizedScope: Only the Vela Retail training storage service in this session. All objects are synthetic.
riskSummary: Publicly readable backups leak customer records, credentials and internal markers. Attackers routinely scan for predictable bucket names.
remediation: Default buckets to private, require authenticated access for exports, scope credentials per bucket, and monitor anonymous read attempts.
conclusion: You proved that a backup bucket was anonymously readable and remediated it by requiring an access key, while keeping the intended public CDN working.

objectives.title: Read an exposed backup
objectives.description: Enumerate the storage buckets from the console, then read a database snapshot anonymously and submit the internal marker it contains.

hints.text: List bucket contents with `curl -s $CF_TARGET_URL/storage/vela-backups | jq`. Then fetch an object path directly.

objectives.title: Require an access key for backups
objectives.description: Apply the ACL policy so backups reject anonymous reads. The live check verifies anonymous denial, authorized access with the demo key, and that the public bucket still serves objects.

hints.text: Apply `{"requireAuthForBackups": true}` with labctl, then read the bucket again with `-H 'x-vela-key: vela-demo-key-2024'`.

walkthrough.title: Enumerate buckets
walkthrough.body: The console lists bucket names and visibility. Backups should never be public.

walkthrough.title: Read the snapshot
walkthrough.body: Object names are listed in the bucket index. Fetch the snapshot directly.

walkthrough.title: Apply the ACL
walkthrough.body: Require an access key for backups, then confirm anonymous access is denied while the demo key still works.
